items.title: Duncan Sheik Dies at 56
items.summary: The musician was best known for his 1996 single “Barely Breathing” and his Tony-winning work on Broadway’s Spring Awakening

items.title: The National’s Matt Berninger Releases Type It Up EP and New Video
items.summary: “People were mishearing the lyric, ‘That would look good in a black letter font’ as ‘I would look good in a black leather thong,’ so I decided to swap the chorus,” he says of the title track

items.title: Laurentius the Profit Found Heaven in a Cave
items.summary: The Berlin artist traveled to a cave church in Turkey to record an album where mistakes, echoes, and rough edges are essential to the story. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily.

items.title: Curly Castro, “Yaphet”
items.summary: Curly Castro draws on the sound of pulpy, Blaxpoitation cinema for his latest batch of songs. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily.
